answer_1.quote: Grammatical Error Correction (GEC) is the task of automatically detecting and correcting errors in text

answer_2.quote: For English evaluation, following , we use ER-RANT and M2 (Dahlmeier and Ng, 2012) to evaluate GEC models on BEA-Test set and CoNLL14-Test set, respectively. For Chinese experiments, following , models are evaluated on MuCGEC and FCGEC test sets using ChERRANT. Precision, recall, and F0.5 values are reported metrics for all the experiments.
